diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed failed connectivity only for paths involving user1, with ICMP redirects from leaf2 gateway IPs (10.10.40.1 and 10.10.50.1) toward an incorrect next hop. Read leaf2 running config and found static route 10.10.10.0/24 pointing to next-hop-group ibn-wrt-m1 with nexthop 10.10.50.10 instead of the fabric next-hop-group to-leaf1. Updated leaf2 route 10.10.10.0/24 to use next-hop-group to-leaf1, then validated public success criteria successfully: all lab connectivity checks passed.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf2, the static route to 10.10.10.0/24 (toward user1 in users_vlan) points to the wrong next hop 10.10.50.10, an address on the wrong egress instead of the path via leaf1.

arguments.reason: leaf2 static route for 10.10.10.0/24 points to next-hop-group ibn-wrt-m1 with nexthop 10.10.50.10, matching the ICMP redirects from 10.10.40.1/10.10.50.1 toward 10.50.10.10 and breaking connectivity to user1; healthy peer routes on leaf2 use next-hop-group to-leaf1 over fabric links.

action.command: set / network-instance default static-routes route 10.10.10.0/24 next-hop-group to-leaf1 admin-state enable
